connector.name: Withingsmcp
connector.registryDescription: Privacy-first, unofficial Withings MCP server for AI health, sleep, activity and heart-rate agents.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package withings-mcp-unofficial. Access is granted through an authorisation flow, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the davidmosiah account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: The record references an OAuth flow, so expect a browser consent step rather than a static key. Confirm the scopes on the consent screen before you approve.

env.name: WITHINGS_CLIENT_ID
env.description: Withings OAuth client ID. Optional when configured with withings-mcp-server setup.

env.name: WITHINGS_CLIENT_SECRET
env.description: Withings OAuth client secret. Prefer withings-mcp-server setup so this secret is stored in ~/.withings-mcp/config.json instead of MCP client config.

env.name: WITHINGS_REDIRECT_URI
env.description: Redirect URI configured in the Withings Developer Dashboard. Optional when configured with withings-mcp-server setup.

env.name: WITHINGS_TOKEN_PATH
env.description: Optional local path for OAuth tokens. Defaults to ~/.withings-mcp/tokens.json.

env.name: WITHINGS_PRIVACY_MODE
env.description: Optional payload mode: summary, structured, or raw. Defaults to structured. raw means full Withings API payloads, not continuous 24/7 raw sensor telemetry.

env.name: WITHINGS_CACHE
env.description: Optional SQLite cache toggle. Set to true or sqlite to enable.

env.name: WITHINGS_CACHE_PATH
env.description: Optional local SQLite cache path. Defaults to ~/.withings-mcp/cache.sqlite.

env.name: WITHINGS_NO_CACHE
env.description: Set to true to bypass the in-memory HTTP response cache (60s TTL for GET only). POST/PUT/DELETE and 4xx/5xx responses are never cached regardless. Note: Withings's wbsapi.withings.net is POST-only today, so this is currently a no-op.
